caption: The drawing depicts a ship’s figurehead, which is a carved, sculptural representation of a female figure attached to the prow of a ship. The figurehead is colored in shades of white, depicting the figure’s draped clothing and facial features in detail. The woman has wavy hair and wears a floral crown, as well as a necklace and a sash around her torso, both colored in a rich orange-brown hue. The rest of the figurehead, which is the part of the ship to which the figure is attached, is rendered in a dark brown or black shade. The background of the composition is a solid, untextured medium blue, creating a stark contrast with the lighter colors of the figurehead. The image is focused on the bow area, with the head and upper body of the figurehead prominently projecting out and facing to the right, with no other objects or elements present in the background.
title: Figurehead
